title: Fubar API Studio workspace
description: fubar.json at a workspace root. Committed: nothing secret belongs here.

id.description: Stable id. Keys this workspace's secrets in the OS keyring.

format.description: Which shape collections/ is in. Absent means requests - one <name>.json per request, what every workspace written before endpoints existed holds. THIS FIELD DECIDES, never the files on disk: read once when the workspace opens, so nothing has to guess which shape it is in from what it happens to find. An existing workspace is never converted on open; "Convert to endpoints..." does it explicitly, with a backup and a preview.

variables.description: Workspace-wide defaults - the lowest-precedence variable source, below the active environment. For what is true about the API rather than about one deployment of it.
